item.description:
High Quality】This dragon is made of high quality resin, durable and lightweight.
 Ensure the toy is environmentally friendly, durable and harmless. Its articulated design allows it to be positioned in a variety of positions, making it a fun and interactive desktop toy!
MULTIPLE DECORATIVE FUNCTIONS】This dragon can be placed on a desk, car dashboard, bedroom or even inside a computer case.
 It can also be placed in a fish tank as a decorative object, making it the perfect decoration for anyone who likes to decorate!

SIZE AND PACKAGING: You will receive articulated crystal dragons measuring 30cm/12 inches. 

These 12 inch dragons are skillfully crafted using stunning 3D printing technology, making them the perfect decoration for your home or office.
